(the “Group”) have recommended a final dividend of Kenya Shillings two and fifty cents (KShs. 2.50) having paid an interim dividend of Kenya Shillings one (KShs. 1.00) for each ordinary share of Kenya Shillings one (KShs. 1.00) on the issued and paid up share capital of the company subject to shareholder approval.
